title: Speaking — Everyday comfort
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on everyday comfort.

questions: When do you normally walk rather than take transport?
Which local route do you enjoy walking along?
Do you usually walk alone or with someone?
What would encourage you to walk more where you live?
What conditions make a place comfortable for you?
Do you find it easy to work in shared spaces?

part2.topic: Describe a place that paid particular attention to visitors' comfort.
part2.closing: and explain why you considered the design successful.

questions: How do age and ability influence what makes a public place comfortable?
What inexpensive changes can make public buildings more welcoming?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to everyday comfort?
